text:
maya: heads-up — preflight eval flagged summarizer v4.2.1 on the long-form clarity slice. looks non-trivial.

deploybot: preflight-eval FAILURE for summarizer_v4.2.1 — clarity Δ = -3.4% (threshold -1.0%). sample_size=250. link: https://ci/reports/1759991111

alina: thanks. can we get the failing examples? short look first pls.

deploybot: sample snippets attached in CI report. examples show truncation and hallucinated sections for >800 tokens.

ross: wow that's larger than typical noise. is this concentrated on a single prompt family or across several?

qa-bot: breakdown: 78% of failures come from prompt_group=long-docs, template=meeting-summary, average input tokens=1.2k

ben: any infra/quant changes in this build? quant profile for v4.2.1 was updated in last merge.

alina: yes we rolled quant-profile-2026-02-15 in the compile step. could be kernel-level change.

maya: product/PM input? @jo

jo: not great timing — we promised a patch release in this window. if it's a real regression we should hold and patch asap.

alina: propose two parallel actions:
1) rerun preflight with sample_size=1000 focused on long-docs
2) pin release to summarizer_v4.2.0 for this window and open a bisect job on quant-profile

maya: I agree with both. can deploybot run a full-sample rerun now and start a canary pin if rerun still fails?

deploybot: queued: `run_eval --suite=preflight-clarity --samples=1000 --slice=long-docs --model=summarizer_v4.2.1`.

ross: add metrics: please include ROUGE-L, factuality score, and hallucination count in the rerun output.

deploybot: will include. ETA ~45m.

ben: I'll stand up a temp nodepool with older kernels in case we need to compare perf between quant profiles.

alina: bisect plan: revert quant-profile commit SHA abc123 on a candidate binary and rerun failing examples. if regression repros, we pin and hotfix compile pipeline.

jo: also update release notes draft to mention we delayed to validate quality — keep the customer-facing text minimal: "QA recheck in progress; patch expected".

maya: OK. decision for now: hold release window. action items:
- @deploybot rerun (in progress)
- @alina start bisect if rerun confirms
- @ben prep older-nodepool for comparisons
- @jo update release notes and notify comms if we keep hold >2h

alina: taking ownership of bisect.

ross: if rerun shows only a small delta (<1.0%) we could still ship with a canary route to v4.2.1 at 5% traffic and monitor. if >1.0, pin.

maya: agreed. threshold rule stands.

deploybot: rerun complete: clarity Δ = -3.1% over 1000 samples, hallucination count increased by 28%.

jo: that's above threshold. move to pin plan.

deploybot: executing route pin: summarizer -> v4.2.0 for release-window. canary rollback path left intact.

ben: nodepool ready for comparisons.

alina: bisect started, first revert candidate reproduces regression. filing ticket: INF-3421 with logs and repro steps.

maya: thanks. @commops notify: release_window held; pinned to v4.2.0; follow-up investigating quant-profile. I'll update the release notes now.

jo: add runbook note: if hotfix ready within 6h, we can fast-track a micro-release. otherwise keep scheduled window closed.

maya: copying final text for release notes edit: "Release delayed: additional QA revealed quality regression in long-form summarization for candidate model. We have pinned the release to the previous stable model and are investigating. Customers on the release window see no change." — ok to publish?

jo: LGTM.

alina: continuing triage, will post findings in INF-3421.

maya: closing thread — hold in place. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
